supportContactRegions.method: At frozen GLB44109 time0, clip actual posed source triangles against XZ footprint. Posterior bilateral gluteus lower boundary supports seat; anterior bilateral rectus upper boundary fits thigh restraint. Lower-body pose static over rep. All-source collision checks remain independent. Tiny positive gaps isolate float export precision, not anatomical skin thickness.
supportContactRegions.limits: Source muscle surfaces are not skin, loaded soles, seat pressure or soft-tissue compression. Proximity and geometric clearance do not establish physical contact or anatomical validation.
supportContactRegions.footPrecisionNote: Round1 runtime minimum was 1.07547 micrometres inside platform; move actual solid top to .21416m, leaving 12.9245 micrometres below lowest sampled original foot tissue. Independent collision epsilon unchanged.

scope: Baked two-arm analytic IK, fixed bone lengths, moving shoulder girdle and attachment-aware back skinning; original source hands; illustrative uncalibrated shoulder angles, no force or activation simulation
